title: Playboy January 2008 Adrianne Curry Tina Fey Mike Tyson Complete w/ Centerfold
condition_description: Complete w/ centerfold. Edge wear and small chips along the spine edge and top-left corner of the front; small chips and nicks along the bottom edge of the back cover. See photos.
description:
Playboy magazine, January 2008 Holiday Anniversary Issue. Original $6.99 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold. Cover: Adrianne Curry.

Cover features: Eyes Wide Open - Adrianne Curry pictorial; Tina Fey interview; 20Q with Helena Bonham Carter; bingeing with Artie Lange; Jimmy Breslin; toasting wine with Robert Coover; a tragic war story; Paris and Lindsay's year in review; 11 pages of Playmates; surprising revelations about the young Mike Tyson; new fiction by John Updike.

Back cover: Woodford Reserve bourbon ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
